太阳表面每一点都向四面八方发光。很小的叶隙只允许一束很窄的方向穿过，于是来自太阳: Every point on the Sun emits light in every direction. A tiny leaf gap admits only a narrow bundle, so light from different parts of the Sun rearranges on the ground into an inverted solar image. Because the Sun is nearly round, those images usually look like circles.
